race.description: Belle Property Belle Of The Burdekin Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: The $50,000 Belle Of The Burdekin. Former NSW galloper BIANCA MIA (7) just ran into one better over this track and trip when having her first run for the new stable and should find this assignment easier than what she faced down south. Will be ready to peak now third run back from the spell and is sure to be right there when the whips are cracking. FOOLS PLAY (15) grows a leg for rider Morrison who has two wins and a placing from just four steers. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and rates a genuine top-three prospect. KOBAYASTAR (4) has placed five of six over this course and distance and is usually thereabouts. A must for the exotics players. EMILIA JANE (9) returned in fine fashion with a solid Mackay victory and will have derived a stack of confidence from that outing. Can go back-to-back. COLOURS OF AUTUMN (1) next best despite the awkward draw.
